narr: Morning convection aided by a wave progressing overhead trained over a stretch of NW lower MI from Leelanau county to Kalkaska county, producing a swath of 2.5-4+ of rainfall with reported flash flooding in Traverse City. A second round of storms initiated along a cold front advancing across northern Michigan during the afternoon, eventually producing damaging wind gusts in Alpena. These winds brought several trees down in Washington Avenue Park.
ev: Flooding at 14th St and Veterans Dr in Traverse City.
lsr: FLOODING DEVELOPING AT 14TH ST AND VETERANS DR IN TRAVERSE CITY. ROAD BECOMING IMPASSABLE.
